world.title: US resumes Iran naval blockade, launches fourth straight day of strikes over Strait of Hormuz
world.summary: The United States has resumed its naval blockade of Iranian ports and coastal areas, marking the fourth consecutive day of military strikes in the region. Central Command (Centcom) confirmed that American forces restarted the blockade following additional strikes against Iranian military targets. This escalation reflects ongoing tensions between the U.S. and Iran over activities in the Strait of Hormuz.

world.title: US eases Russia sanctions bill, cuts tariff threat on India and China from 500% to 100%
world.summary: US senators introduced a revised Russia sanctions bill aimed at pressuring Moscow and its significant energy buyers, including India and China. The updated legislation reduces the proposed tariff threat on these countries from 500% to 100%. This change reflects a strategic adjustment in the US approach to sanctions while maintaining a focus on energy-related transactions with Russia.

world.title: Trump backs bill that could hit India with 500% tariffs over Russian oil trade
world.summary: Donald Trump has endorsed a US sanctions bill that may impose tariffs of up to 500% on countries purchasing Russian oil, affecting nations like India and China. During a discussion, he acknowledged the need to evaluate the situation, stating, "We have to look. That hasn't been discussed yet." This development could strain India’s trade relations with the United States.

business.title: Based On Tekton Launching Soon
business.summary: Nissan plans to launch a new 7-seater vehicle based on the Tekton in the Indian market. The company has experienced significant ups and downs, with successes like the Micra, Sunny, and Terrano, contrasted by the failure of the Datsun brand. This upcoming model aims to revitalize Nissan's presence in India, moving forward from previous challenges.

business.title: Stocks to Watch Today: Ather Energy, Belrise Industries, PDS, Kirloskar Brothers, Kusumgar, IOL Chemicals, Delhivery, L&T Technology in focus on 15 July
business.summary: On July 15, 2026, several stocks will be in focus, including L&T Technology Services, Tata Elxsi, Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers, Ather Energy, Belrise Industries, PDS, Kirloskar Brothers, Easy Trip Planners, and IOL Chemicals and Pharmaceuticals. Investors are advised to monitor these companies for potential developments, including investments, deals, earnings, and acquisitions impacting their performance.

business.title: Maharashtra FDA suspends licences of 3 Mumbai restaurants over hygiene lapses
business.summary: The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has suspended the licenses of three Mumbai restaurants due to hygiene violations. This action follows the recent closure of K Rustom ice cream parlour, which was found to have rats, flies, and expired flavoring agents during an inspection. The FDA continues to enforce food safety regulations in the region.

technology.title: Patchpocalypse Now: Microsoft tops last month's record with 622 Patch Tuesday CVEs
technology.summary: Microsoft's recent Patch Tuesday surpassed last month's record by addressing 622 Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs), a significant increase from the previous month's 206 CVEs. This surge highlights the growing number of security issues within Microsoft products, prompting the company to implement extensive patches to enhance system security and protect users from potential threats.

technology.title: Spotify brings chatbot-powered music discovery
technology.summary: Spotify has introduced a new feature called Talk to Spotify, allowing Premium subscribers to engage with the platform using natural language conversations. This chatbot-powered music discovery tool leverages artificial intelligence to enhance user interaction, enabling personalized music recommendations and a more intuitive experience. The feature is currently in beta, aimed at improving how users explore and enjoy music.

technology.title: PlayStation's Social Feeds Are Still on Fire
technology.summary: Sony's decision to discontinue physical disc production for PlayStation has sparked significant backlash on social media, with users expressing frustration over the move. Analysts suggest that the company's focus on digital profits makes a reversal of this decision unlikely. Developers utilizing PlayStation's promotional channels are facing challenges as their work is overshadowed by the ongoing disc-related complaints.

sports.title: France vs Spain, FIFA World Cup semifinal LIVE: Porro scores as Spain goes 2-0 up
sports.summary: Spain is currently leading France 2-0 in the FIFA World Cup semifinal at AT&T Stadium in Arlington on July 14, 2026. Porro scored one of the goals for Spain. France made tactical changes by recalling Bradley Barcola to the attack and Aurelien Tchouameni in midfield. The match is part of the ongoing World Cup tournament.

sports.title: Tottenham demand €50m for Romero, too expensive for Inter
sports.summary: Tottenham Hotspur are asking for €50 million to sell defender Cristian Romero, according to Sportitalia. This high price makes it unlikely that Inter Milan will secure his signature, especially as Barcelona is also interested in the player. The situation suggests that Inter may not be able to compete financially for Romero amid the ongoing transfer discussions.

sports.title: Shubman Gill's 80, Axar-Washington stand give India 1-0 lead over England in ODI series
sports.summary: Shubman Gill scored 80 runs as India secured a six-wicket victory over England in the first ODI at Edgbaston on Tuesday. This win gives India a 1-0 lead in the three-match series. Gill's performance continued his strong record at the venue, contributing significantly to India's successful chase. The match showcased India's batting strength and strategic gameplay.

health.title: IMA issues diectives on Chandipura virus in Gujarat
health.summary: The Gujarat State Branch of the Indian Medical Association (GSB-IMA) has issued an advisory regarding the Chandipura virus, urging pediatricians to assess children's medical histories and symptoms such as high fever and convulsions, following three reported deaths. The medical body emphasized the importance of strict preventive measures to curb the spread of this dangerous sandfly-borne virus.

health.title: 3 children dead, 4 on life support as Chandipura virus outbreak hits Gujarat
health.summary: Gujarat has reported 32 suspected cases of the Chandipura virus since July 1, with seven confirmed infections among children. Three children have died, and four others are on life support. The outbreak has prompted the health department to enhance surveillance, treatment, and sandfly-control measures in response to the rising number of cases and fatalities.

health.title: FDA's Traceback Endeavor: Tackling Cyclosporiasis Outbreak
health.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is investigating several produce items to determine the source of a cyclosporiasis outbreak. This intestinal infection is typically contracted through contaminated raw fruits and vegetables. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention highlights the risks associated with consuming contaminated produce, prompting the FDA's traceback efforts to ensure food safety.

science.title: Scientists use sound waves to create protective crystal coatings on crops
science.summary: Researchers at RMIT University have created a novel coating method using high-frequency sound waves to spray protective crystal films onto plant leaves. This innovative technique generates a fine mist that forms durable layers on delicate surfaces, enhancing crop protection. The method aims to improve agricultural practices by providing a safe and effective way to shield plants from environmental threats.

science.title: Earliest galaxies were well organised less than a billion years after Big Bang, reveals IUCAA study
science.summary: A study by IUCAA utilizing the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) has discovered spheroidal galaxies formed 400 to 900 million years after the Big Bang. These galaxies exhibit the Kormendy relation, indicating a level of organization previously thought to develop later in cosmic history. This finding suggests that early galaxies were more structured than previously understood.

science.title: A new fabrication technique for the ultra-clean manufacturing of 2D heterostructures
science.summary: Researchers have introduced a novel fabrication technique for the ultra-clean manufacturing of 2D heterostructures. This method is anticipated to facilitate the development of next-generation devices, which could significantly advance research in quantum computing. The innovation aims to enhance the quality and performance of materials used in quantum technologies, potentially leading to breakthroughs in the field.

entertainment.title: Aamir Khan faces fatwa after marrying Gauri Spratt; cleric objects to interfaith marriage: 'Gair Muslim se shaadi karna haraam hai'
entertainment.summary: Aamir Khan is facing backlash following his marriage to Gauri Spratt, with a Muslim cleric objecting to their interfaith union. The cleric stated that marrying outside the faith is impermissible according to his interpretation of Islamic law. This controversy arises shortly after the couple's wedding, drawing attention to the challenges of interfaith relationships within certain religious communities.

entertainment.title: Ayodhya priest's remark sparks uproar
entertainment.summary: A religious leader has offered a Rs 5 crore reward for the killing of actor Aamir Khan, following ongoing backlash related to his marriage to Gauri Spratt. The situation has escalated, with protests, effigy burnings, and allegations of "love jihad" from members of the Bajrang Dal. Khan has faced increasing hostility since the announcement of their marriage.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: Daily astrological predictions for July 15, 2026
entertainment.summary: Horoscope predictions for July 15, 2026, provide insights into the astrological influences affecting each of the 12 zodiac signs. The analysis includes the movements of planets and their alignments, offering guidance for individuals based on their signs. Readers can explore how these celestial events may impact their daily lives and decisions, enhancing their understanding of personal astrology.
